# Alexander Mescheryakov

> Personal portfolio of Alexander Mescheryakov — UX/UI designer and front-end developer who designs and builds digital products, improving experiences and interfaces to match user needs and business goals with minimum waste.

## About

Alexander Mescheryakov is a UX and UI designer and front-end developer based online at sibsfinx.github.io. He focuses on user-centred design and front-end implementation of digital products.
